status: DRAFT v2, 1 Nov 2026: edge-case pilot set (exploratory). Cases S1-X4 adapted from an external review (Gemini, 1 Nov 2026), A6 and X5 restored from v1; keys written by Claude. The author must check every key before results are used. Rules: protocol section 5.

household.place: detached house in Konstanz with rooftop PV, a 10 kWh home battery, a heat pump and an EV charger
household.car_arrival: the car usually arrives at about 18:00 with about 30 % charge; the current charge is given with each message

plans.text: I need the car at 80% by 07:30 tomorrow morning. Keep the house at normal temperature.
We will be away at the office from 08:30 to 17:00 today. Run the dishwasher so it's finished before we get home.
Warm the house to 22-23 °C between 06:00 and 08:00 tomorrow, and add 15 kWh to the car by 08:00.
Working from home all day today, don't need the car. Run the washing machine between 10:00 and 15:00.
Charge the car to 100% by 06:30 tomorrow, and lower the heating to 18-20 °C from midnight until 06:00.
We're going out from 18:00 to 22:00 today. Have the car at 70% by 18:00 and finish the washing machine by 17:30.
Car at 60% by 08:00, please.

change.text: I'm back and plugged in. Something came up: I need the car at 75% by 16:30 today.

plans.text: We're out from 08:30 to 18:00 today.

change.text: Heading home early! I'll be back at 14:30 instead of 18:00, and please warm the house to 22-23 °C from 14:30 until 21:00.

plans.text: We're out from 19:30 to 22:30 tonight. Dishwasher done by 21:00.

change.text: We cancelled our evening plans and are staying home tonight. Also, no rush on the dishwasher, just have it done by 07:00 tomorrow.

plans.text: Car at 65% by 18:00 for the gym.

change.text: Skipping the 18:00 gym trip today. Instead, charge the car to 85% by 07:00 tomorrow morning.

plans.text: Car at 70% for 07:00 tomorrow.

change.text: Actually, bump the car target to 90% for my 07:00 departure tomorrow, and run the washing machine overnight so it's ready by 06:00.

plans.text: I have a long highway trip tomorrow morning, so make sure the car is well charged.
We're visiting friends for a few hours this afternoon, you can turn down the heat while we're gone.
Charge the car to 90% before I head out, and run the dishwasher by 18:00.
Plugged the car in for my 07:00 commute tomorrow. Also make the house extra warm tonight.
I need the car charged up by lunchtime, and run a load of washing today.
We're away for the weekend.
Just got home. I need 25 kWh added to the car before I leave at 05:00.
We're away from 09:00 to 17:00 so put the heating into away saving mode, and keep the house at a steady 23 °C from 08:00 to 18:00.
I'm driving the car to the office from 08:00 to 17:00 tomorrow. Make sure you charge it to 90% using our rooftop solar between 11:00 and 15:00.
Charge the car to 100% before we leave for dinner at 20:00.
Car at 80% by 7:00 tomorrow, and don't use any electricity from the grid tonight.

ev.infeasible_because: no grid at night: 20 kWh needed, the home battery holds 10 kWh and there is no PV in a January night
